nodes.name: README.md
nodes.summary: Comprehensive reference for the @waggle/benchmarks-harness four-cell ablation harness, documenting the raw/filtered/compressed/full-context cells, CLI flags, JSONL output schema, dataset requirements, and reproducibility controls for Waggle memory and prompt-evolution benchmarks.

nodes.name: package.json
nodes.summary: Package manifest for the private @waggle/benchmarks-harness ESM module, defining the waggle-bench CLI binary entry point and declaring dependencies on @waggle/agent and @waggle/core with tsx and vitest as dev tooling.

nodes.name: tsconfig.json
nodes.summary: TypeScript compiler configuration for the benchmarks harness, targeting ES2022 with ESNext modules, strict mode, declaration maps, and source maps enabled, compiling from src/ to dist/.
